# Rikka

> A modern Web Components toolkit with fine-grained reactivity based on TC39 Signals. Zero virtual DOM, ~16KB gzip, type-safe, and LLM-friendly. Three published packages: `@takanashi/rikka-signal`, `@takanashi/rikka-dom`, `@takanashi/rikka-elements`.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention. If you're an AI coding agent, start with the skills index below.

## Skills (start here)

- [Skills Index](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/README.md): Loading strategy and decision tree for the 14 task-oriented skill files. Read first.
- [Overview](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/overview.md): What rikka is, the three packages, design principles, when to use it.

## Reactive state

- [Reactive State](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/reactive-state.md): `signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `untracked`. The TC39-Signals-based reactive primitives.

## DOM

- [DOM Creation](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/dom-creation.md): `h()`, tag helpers, `h\`` template literal. Creates real DOM elements.
- [Signal Binding](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/signal-binding.md): Binding signals to text nodes, attributes, template slots. Fine-grained vs coarse-grained.
- [Control Flow](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/control-flow.md): `For` (lists), `Show` / `When` / `Switch` / `Match` (conditionals).
- [Form Binding](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/form-binding.md): Two-way binding for `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>`.
- [SVG](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/svg.md): SVG elements, namespace handling, name-collision tags (`a`, `script`, `style`, `title`).

## Custom elements

- [Custom Element](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/custom-element.md): `defineElement`, `attributes`, `events`, `methods`, `render` — the full `ElementConfig` reference.
- [Shadow DOM & Styling](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/shadow-dom-styling.md): `css\``, `inlineStyle\``, `adoptStyle`, `:host` selector.
- [Template Binding](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/template-binding.md): The `template` option of `defineElement` with `{{name}}` / `{{@event}}` syntax.
- [Composition](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/composition.md): Composable functions + `MyElement.h(...)` to embed a custom element.

## Operations

- [Browser Compatibility](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/browser-compatibility.md): Browser support matrix and polyfills for Custom Elements / Shadow DOM / CSSStyleSheet.
- [Common Pitfalls](https://yw662.github.io/rikka/skills/common-pitfalls.md): Cross-cutting mistakes — read this before generating rikka code. Covers the 4 rikka-specific LLM footguns.

## Optional

- [Package READMEs](https://github.com/yw662/rikka/tree/main/utils): `@takanashi/rikka-signal`, `@takanashi/rikka-dom`, `@takanashi/rikka-elements` — short API summaries with links back to the skills.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/yw662/rikka): Source, issues, examples.
